Maharashtra TET Exam Papers Leaked From Agra Press for Rs 8,000

Question papers for the Maharashtra Teacher Eligibility Test (TET) were allegedly smuggled out of a press in Agra for ₹8,000. According to chargesheets filed, the papers were hidden inside shoe insoles. The leak occurred from the press where the examination materials were being printed.
